The homemade difference

Baked the way you would bake it at home

  • Made Fresh to Order

    Each order is prepared after you place it, so your treat arrives as fresh as we can make it.

  • Prepared with Care

    Every cake and batch is made by hand, with attention to texture, decoration and finish.

  • Perfect for Every Celebration

    From birthdays to anniversaries, we make something that fits the occasion and the people you are sharing it with.

About the brand

A little love in every bite

Home Made Cravings is built on a simple idea: a treat tastes better when someone has thought about it, measured it carefully and baked it with their own hands.

We make cakes, desserts and baked treats for everyday moments and for the occasions that matter most. Every order gets the same attention, whether it is a single box of brownies or a celebration cake.
